2 Or more years of experience with electromechanical assemblies or electronic manufacturing.
Experience with electronic assembly and testing in the medical device industry preferred.
Technical certifications preferred.
Strong attention to detail.
Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings and test procedures.
Familiarity with FDA regulations and ISO standards.

cond_0647.intro: We are looking for an experienced electronics technician to join our team at a leading medical device company. You will own the testing and assembly of electronic components and subassemblies, ensuring quality and regulatory standards are met. You will take accountability for accurate recordkeeping, drive adherence to quality and profitability metrics, and actively support continuous improvement and compliance initiatives including FDA regulations and ISO standards. You will uphold environmental, health, and safety protocols and maintain clear communication across all levels of the organization.
cond_0647.responsibilities:
Execute testing and assembly of electronic components and subassemblies
Read and interpret engineering drawings and test procedures
Ensure adherence to quality and profitability metrics
Maintain accurate records for traceability and address quality issues
Prioritize work effectively and represent the company professionally during tours
Lead participation in continuous improvement initiatives
Ensure compliance with FDA regulations and ISO standards
Uphold environmental, health, and safety protocols
Drive positive communication and collaboration across all levels of the organization
